statements.t: In HCC, we remain encouraged by the previously reported interim results for TTI-101 and look forward to the topline readout in early first quarter of 2027, which will help inform our next steps.”

The Company has completed a Phase 1 healthy volunteer study of TTI-109 and plans to initiate clinical trials of TTI-109 in ulcerative colitis pending IND clearance and the availability of additional funding.
